title: Parallel Cloud Reductions: thread, atomic, mutex
hints: Chunking: T = clamp(num_threads, 1, n). Thread t handles [t*n/T, (t+1)*n/T). Using size_t math gives contiguous, balanced chunks that cover everything.
Centroid: give each thread its own slot `partial[t]` (no sharing while running), join all threads, then sum the partials on the main thread.
Capture the loop index by value: `workers.emplace_back([&, t] { ... });`. Counting: count locally inside the thread, then do ONE `total.fetch_add(local)` at the end.
HitCounter: `std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(m_);` in every member, including the const ones (so the mutex is `mutable`).
